tree-sitter-groovy 0.1.2 (https://github.com/amaanq/tree-sitter-groovy, tag v0.1.2,
commit 70efb0b9b50f95bcbd89dcfd42b275e0304e10cf), vendored in vendor/tree-sitter-groovy/.

Licence basis: a declaration, not a licence file. The upstream Cargo.toml,
retained as vendor/tree-sitter-groovy/UPSTREAM-LICENSE-DECLARATION.toml, reads:

    authors = ["Amaan Qureshi <amaanq12@gmail.com>"]
    license = "MIT"

Neither the v0.1.2 tag nor its Python source distribution contains a licence
file or a copyright notice (vendor/tree-sitter-groovy/SOURCE.json). Checked
again on 2026-10-13: v0.1.2 is still the latest tag, and the default branch has
no licence file. No copyright line is supplied here because upstream gives
none. The standard MIT licence text, which the declaration names, follows.
